en: Fixed session titles, memory recall and prompt hooks failing on Mantle or behind gateways that reject structured outputs; added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUTS` to turn structured outputs off
zh: 修复在 Mantle 上或经由拒绝结构化输出的网关时，session 标题、记忆召回和 prompt hook 失败的问题；新增 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUTS` 以关闭结构化输出
